summary: R218 makes the final DX11 ExactSamples boundary explicitly require complete fixed-function stage/sampler observation and translation readiness in addition to the existing fixed-function, resource, input-layout, output-state and shader exactness gates. This is diagnostic/activation-readiness hardening only; NativeDrawPath remains dormant.
